summary: Full end-to-end verification of the new COD order-capture flow. Backend: 10/10 pytest assertions pass (products catalogue, order create with server-side totals & shipping rules, unknown-SKU 400, Pydantic 422 for missing name/phone/short pincode/empty items, GET roundtrip & 404). Frontend: Playwright verified cta-order opens OrderModal, all 6 products render grouped by size, increment/decrement + live subtotal/shipping/total math (2*PJ-500-12 + 3*PJ-1L-1 = ₹520 free shipping), continue-to-details disabled while empty, place-order disabled until required fields filled, form submit navigates to /success/:orderId, success page renders order_number (PJ-YYMMDD-XXXX), receipt items, receipt-total, receipt-customer-name, and 'litres given back' = 27. Mission CTA preloads PJ-500-12 qty=1. Modal close via X button AND backdrop click both work. /success/{fake-uuid} shows the 'Order not found' error via data-testid='success-error'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses `@app.on_event('shutdown')` which is deprecated in FastAPI; consider migrating to the lifespan handler in a future pass (non-blocking).

Frontend `canSubmit` checks pincode length client-side as >=4 while Pydantic accepts 4–12; this matches, but no numeric-only enforcement is done — a user could type letters and the backend would still accept it. Consider tightening to Indian 6-digit pincode.
OrderModal `handleSubmit` sends `email: undefined` and `notes: undefined` which axios/JSON serializes as omitted keys — fine because backend Optional accepts missing. Good.
Product images use the same BOTTLE_IMG placeholder for every SKU; consider distinct thumbnails per size for clarity (cosmetic).
Success page shows `success-error` testid for unknown order (matches request spec); the request spec says 'Order not found' error should show — this is present.
test_credentials: n/a — public COD flow, no auth
seed_data_creation: Live orders were created in `orders` collection via the API during tests (TEST_ prefixed customer names not used; customer name is 'Arindam Chatterjee'). Consider a cleanup job if the same DB is used for demos.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend API at https://prokritir-jol.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Products: 6 SKUs (PJ-500-1 ₹20, PJ-500-12 ₹200, PJ-500-24 ₹380, PJ-1L-1 ₹40, PJ-1L-12 ₹400, PJ-1L-24 ₹760). Free shipping >=₹300, else ₹40. Order number pattern: PJ-YYMMDD-XXXX (4 hex chars uppercase). Order ID is a UUID4 string. GET /api/orders/{unknown-uuid} returns 404 'Order not found'. Frontend testids fully match the spec — cta-order, cta-order-mission, order-modal, order-modal-close, order-modal-backdrop, products-step, details-step, product-{sku}, increment/decrement/qty-{sku}, cart-summary, cart-line-{sku}, summary-subtotal/shipping/total, continue-to-details, back-to-products, place-order-btn, input-name/phone/email/address/city/state/pincode/notes, order-error, order-number, copy-order-number, receipt-items, receipt-line-{sku}, receipt-total, receipt-customer-name, order-receipt, success-home-link, back-home-link, continue-story-link, success-error. Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Iteration_1 covered the landing/story animation — do not retest unless main agent changes landing.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found in this iteration.
